"""Topology findings -> candidate exclusion evidence lines (staged, never inserted).

Pure pipeline over pinned bytes. Same inputs + same ``as_of`` -> byte-identical
outputs: no clock, host, absolute path or random id enters any file.

Outputs (all sorted by their id column):

* ``candidates.tsv`` / ``.parquet`` — one line per (company, code, url, quote),
  ``review_status = needs_cio_review``. Only ground maps, only through a rule.
* ``findings.tsv`` / ``.parquet`` — every company-level ground finding, with the
  rules it matched (empty when none). The review queue for unmapped evidence.
* ``context.tsv`` — benefit claims, author positions, AI centres. Never grounds.
* ``sources.tsv`` — bodies registry rows as ``exclusions.sources`` candidates.
* ``identity.tsv`` — one row per unique developer reference and its resolution.
* ``manifest.tsv`` — input digests, rules/snapshot digests, as_of, output digests.
* ``state.tsv`` — processed input digests -> content-addressed extraction cache.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from importlib import resources
from pathlib import Path

from dark.security_master import Reference

from dark.exclusions_feed.identity import (
    RESOLVED,
    CompanySnapshot,
    Identity,
    resolve_many,
)
from dark.exclusions_feed.inputs import (
    CONTEXT,
    CONTEXT_MAPS,
    GROUND,
    GROUND_MAPS,
    INPUTS,
    SOURCES,
    LoadedInput,
    load_inputs,
    parse_tsv,
    sha256_hex,
)

#: Bump when extraction or output shape changes; part of the run key and cache key.
FEED_VERSION = "1"
REVIEW_STATUS = "needs_cio_review"
KEY_COLUMNS = ("cik", "lei", "figi", "isin", "ticker")

FINDING_COLUMNS = (
    "finding_id",
    "source_map",
    "source_file",
    "input_sha256",
    "source_row_sha256",
    "developer",
    "developer_field",
    "country",
    "model",
    "method_id",
    "evidence_url",
    "evidence_pin",
    "quote",
    "quote_sha256",
    "status",
    "source_witness",
    *KEY_COLUMNS,
)
CANDIDATE_COLUMNS = (
    "candidate_id",
    "company_key",
    "identity_status",
    "identity_tier",
    "company_id",
    "company_id_candidate",
    *KEY_COLUMNS,
    "developer",
    "proposed_code",
    "basis",
    "witness",
    "approved_by",
    "rule_ids",
    "sdg_computed",
    "evidence_url",
    "evidence_pin",
    "quote",
    "quote_sha256",
    "source_map",
    "source_file",
    "input_sha256",
    "source_row_sha256",
    "finding_id",
    "review_status",
    "as_of",
)
CONTEXT_COLUMNS = (
    "context_id",
    "source_map",
    "source_file",
    "input_sha256",
    "source_row_sha256",
    "subject",
    "url",
    "quote",
    "quote_sha256",
    "fields_json",
    "as_of",
)
SOURCE_COLUMNS = (
    "source_candidate_id",
    "source_key",
    "source_name",
    "source_type",
    "url",
    "url_status",
    "license",
    "domain",
    "jurisdiction",
    "taxonomy_artifact",
    "terms_url",
    "fetch_status",
    "source_witness",
    "notes",
    "input_sha256",
    "source_row_sha256",
    "review_status",
    "as_of",
)
IDENTITY_COLUMNS = (
    "developer",
    "identity_status",
    "identity_tier",
    "company_id",
    *KEY_COLUMNS,
    "warnings",
    "finding_count",
)
RULE_COLUMNS = (
    "rule_id",
    "map",
    "field",
    "op",
    "value",
    "sub_category_code",
    "basis",
    "witness",
    "approved_by",
    "rationale",
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- TSV io


def to_tsv(columns: tuple[str, ...], rows: list[dict]) -> bytes:
    """Serialize rows; a tab or newline in a value is an error, never rewritten."""
    out = ["\t".join(columns)]
    for row in rows:
        cells = []
        for c in columns:
            v = row.get(c)
            s = "" if v is None else str(v)
            if any(ch in s for ch in "\t\n\r"):
                raise ValueError(f"{c}: value contains a tab or newline")
            cells.append(s)
        out.append("\t".join(cells))
    return ("\n".join(out) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def from_tsv(data: bytes) -> list[dict]:
    return [r for r, _ in parse_tsv(data)[1]]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- rules


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rule:
    rule_id: str
    map: str
    field: str
    op: str
    value: str
    code: str
    basis: str
    witness: str
    approved_by: str

    def matches(self, finding: dict) -> bool:
        cell = finding.get(self.field) or ""
        if self.op == "eq":
            return cell == self.value
        pattern = r"(?<![0-9A-Za-z])" + re.escape(self.value) + r"(?![0-9A-Za-z])"
        return re.search(pattern, cell, flags=re.IGNORECASE) is not None


def default_rules_bytes() -> bytes:
    return resources.files("dark.exclusions_feed").joinpath("rules.tsv").read_bytes()


def load_rules(data: bytes, taxonomy_codes: frozenset[str]) -> list[Rule]:
    """Parse and validate rules. Fails closed on any rule that could misfire."""
    rules: list[Rule] = []
    for r in from_tsv(data):
        rid = r["rule_id"]
        if r["map"] in CONTEXT_MAPS or r["map"] not in GROUND_MAPS:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: map {r['map']!r} is not a ground map")
        if r["sub_category_code"] not in taxonomy_codes:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: {r['sub_category_code']!r} not in taxonomy")
        if r["op"] not in ("eq", "term"):
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: unknown op {r['op']!r}")
        if r["basis"] == "computed" and not r["approved_by"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: basis=computed requires approved_by")
        if r["basis"] not in ("computed", "proposal"):
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: basis must be computed or proposal")
        if r["basis"] == "proposal" and not r["witness"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: a proposal names its witness")
        rules.append(
            Rule(
                rid,
                r["map"],
                r["field"],
                r["op"],
                r["value"],
                r["sub_category_code"],
                r["basis"],
                r["witness"],
                r["approved_by"],
            )
        )
    return sorted(rules, key=lambda x: x.rule_id)


# --------------------------------------------------------------- extraction


def _split_developers(raw: str) -> list[str]:
    """The map's own delimiter: ``A; B`` names two developers."""
    return [p.strip() for p in raw.split(";") if p.strip()]


def extract_findings(inp: LoadedInput) -> list[dict]:
    """One finding per (row, developer) of a ground map."""
    out = []
    for row, row_sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]:
        for dev in _split_developers(row.get("developer", "")):
            quote = row.get("quote", "")
            f = {
                "source_map": inp.spec.map,
                "source_file": inp.spec.relpath,
                "input_sha256": inp.sha256,
                "source_row_sha256": row_sha,
                "developer": dev,
                "developer_field": row.get("developer", ""),
                "country": row.get("country", ""),
                "model": row.get("model", ""),
                "method_id": row.get("method_id", ""),
                "evidence_url": row.get("evidence_url", ""),
                "evidence_pin": row.get("evidence_pin", ""),
                "quote": quote,
                "quote_sha256": sha256_hex(quote.encode("utf-8")) if quote else "",
                "status": row.get("status", ""),
                "source_witness": row.get("witness", ""),
                **{k: row.get(k, "") for k in KEY_COLUMNS},
            }
            f["finding_id"] = sha256_hex(f"{row_sha}\t{dev}".encode())
            out.append(f)
    return out


_SUBJECT_FIELDS = ("developer", "company", "body_id", "author", "name", "id")
_URL_FIELDS = ("evidence_url", "url", "source_url")


def extract_context(inp: LoadedInput, as_of: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Context rows are carried whole (``fields_json``); they ground nothing."""
    out = []
    for row, row_sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]:
        quote = row.get("quote", "")
        out.append(
            {
                "context_id": sha256_hex(f"{inp.spec.relpath}\t{row_sha}".encode()),
                "source_map": inp.spec.map,
                "source_file": inp.spec.relpath,
                "input_sha256": inp.sha256,
                "source_row_sha256": row_sha,
                "subject": next((row[f] for f in _SUBJECT_FIELDS if row.get(f)), ""),
                "url": next((row[f] for f in _URL_FIELDS if row.get(f)), ""),
                "quote": quote,
                "quote_sha256": sha256_hex(quote.encode("utf-8")) if quote else "",
                "fields_json": json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False),
                "as_of": as_of,
            }
        )
    return out


def extract_sources(inp: LoadedInput, as_of: str) -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    for row, row_sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]:
        raw_url = row.get("artifact_url", "")
        url_status, _, url = raw_url.partition(":") if raw_url.startswith("unverified:") else ("", "", raw_url)
        key = f"praxis-body:{row.get('id', '')}"
        out.append(
            {
                "source_candidate_id": sha256_hex(f"{key}\t{url}".encode()),
                "source_key": key,
                "source_name": row.get("name", ""),
                "source_type": row.get("kind", ""),
                "url": url,
                "url_status": url_status or ("present" if url else "absent"),
                "license": row.get("terms_verdict", ""),
                "domain": row.get("domain_claimed", ""),
                "jurisdiction": row.get("jurisdiction", ""),
                "taxonomy_artifact": row.get("taxonomy_artifact", ""),
                "terms_url": row.get("terms_url", ""),
                "fetch_status": row.get("fetch_status", ""),
                "source_witness": row.get("witness", ""),
                "notes": row.get("notes", ""),
                "input_sha256": inp.sha256,
                "source_row_sha256": row_sha,
                "review_status": REVIEW_STATUS,
                "as_of": as_of,
            }
        )
    return out


# -------------------------------------------------------------- candidates


def candidate_id(company_key: str, code: str, evidence_url: str, quote_sha256: str) -> str:
    return sha256_hex("\t".join((company_key, code, evidence_url, quote_sha256)).encode())


def _reference(f: dict) -> Reference:
    return Reference(name=f["developer"], **{k: (f.get(k) or None) for k in KEY_COLUMNS})


def build_candidates(
    findings: list[dict],
    rules: list[Rule],
    identities: dict[Reference, Identity],
    sdg_by_code: dict[str, str],
    as_of: str,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Rule matches on verified, quoted findings -> deduplicated candidate lines."""
    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for f in findings:
        if not f["status"].startswith("verified:") or not f["quote"]:
            continue
        ident = identities[_reference(f)]
        ckey = ident.company_key(f["developer"])
        for rule in rules:
            if rule.map != f["source_map"] or not rule.matches(f):
                continue
            cid = candidate_id(ckey, rule.code, f["evidence_url"], f["quote_sha256"])
            if cid in by_id:
                prev = by_id[cid]
                prev["rule_ids"] = ";".join(sorted({*prev["rule_ids"].split(";"), rule.rule_id}))
                continue
            resolved = ident.status == RESOLVED
            by_id[cid] = {
                "candidate_id": cid,
                "company_key": ckey,
                "identity_status": ident.status,
                "identity_tier": ident.tier,
                "company_id": ident.company_id if resolved else "",
                "company_id_candidate": "" if resolved else (ident.company_id or ""),
                **{k: ident.keys.get(k, "") for k in KEY_COLUMNS},
                "developer": f["developer"],
                "proposed_code": rule.code,
                "basis": rule.basis,
                "witness": rule.witness if rule.basis == "proposal" else "",
                "approved_by": rule.approved_by,
                "rule_ids": rule.rule_id,
                "sdg_computed": sdg_by_code.get(rule.code, ""),
                "evidence_url": f["evidence_url"],
                "evidence_pin": f["evidence_pin"],
                "quote": f["quote"],
                "quote_sha256": f["quote_sha256"],
                "source_map": f["source_map"],
                "source_file": f["source_file"],
                "input_sha256": f["input_sha256"],
                "source_row_sha256": f["source_row_sha256"],
                "finding_id": f["finding_id"],
                "review_status": REVIEW_STATUS,
                "as_of": as_of,
            }
    return [by_id[k] for k in sorted(by_id)]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- build


@dataclass
class BuildResult:
    skipped: bool
    run_key: str
    counts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    candidates_by_code: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    identity_by_status: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    extracted: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    cached: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def _taxonomy_codes(inputs: list[LoadedInput]) -> frozenset[str]:
    tax = next(i for i in inputs if i.spec.map == "taxonomy")
    return frozenset(r["sub_category_code"] for r in json.loads(tax.data))


def _sdg_by_code(inputs: list[LoadedInput]) -> dict[str, str]:
    comp = next(i for i in inputs if i.spec.relpath.endswith("exclusions-sdg/computed.tsv"))
    if not comp.present:
        return {}
    acc: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for r in from_tsv(comp.data):
        acc.setdefault(r["category"], set()).add(r["sdg_code"])
    return {k: ";".join(sorted(v, key=lambda s: [int(p) for p in s.split(".") if p.isdigit()])) for k, v in acc.items()}


def _run_key(inputs: list[LoadedInput], rules_sha: str, snap_digest: str, as_of: str) -> str:
    parts = [f"v{FEED_VERSION}", as_of, rules_sha, snap_digest]
    parts += [f"{i.spec.relpath}={i.sha256 or 'absent'}" for i in inputs]
    return sha256_hex("\n".join(parts).encode())


def _read_manifest(out_dir: Path) -> list[dict]:
    p = out_dir / "manifest.tsv"
    return from_tsv(p.read_bytes()) if p.is_file() else []


def _cached_extract(out_dir: Path, inp: LoadedInput, as_of: str, result: BuildResult) -> list[dict]:
    """Content-addressed: an input whose digest was processed is not re-parsed."""
    role = inp.spec.role
    columns = {GROUND: FINDING_COLUMNS, CONTEXT: CONTEXT_COLUMNS, SOURCES: SOURCE_COLUMNS}[role]
    # Context/sources rows carry as_of, so it is part of their cache key.
    suffix = "" if role == GROUND else f"-{as_of}"
    cache = out_dir / ".cache" / f"{role}-v{FEED_VERSION}-{inp.sha256}{suffix}.tsv"
    if cache.is_file():
        result.cached.append(inp.spec.relpath)
        return from_tsv(cache.read_bytes())
    if role == GROUND:
        rows = extract_findings(inp)
    elif role == CONTEXT:
        rows = extract_context(inp, as_of)
    else:
        rows = extract_sources(inp, as_of)
    cache.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cache.write_bytes(to_tsv(columns, rows))
    result.extracted.append(inp.spec.relpath)
    return rows


def _write_parquet(tsv: Path, parquet: Path) -> bool:
    """Columnar copy via DuckDB (a declared dark-core dependency). Single thread."""
    try:
        import duckdb
    except ModuleNotFoundError:  # pragma: no cover - duckdb is a core dep
        return False
    con = duckdb.connect()
    try:
        con.execute("SET threads TO 1")
        con.execute(
            "COPY (SELECT * FROM read_csv(?, delim='\t', header=true, all_varchar=true, "
            "quote='', escape='', auto_detect=false, columns=?) ) "
            "TO '" + str(parquet).replace("'", "''") + "' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)",
            [str(tsv), {c: "VARCHAR" for c in tsv.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n", 1)[0].split("\t")}],
        )
    finally:
        con.close()
    return True


def build(
    praxis_root: Path,
    out_dir: Path,
    as_of: str,
    *,
    companies: Path | None = None,
    rules_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    parquet: bool = True,
) -> BuildResult:
    """Build the staged outputs. Writes only under ``out_dir``. No DB access."""
    as_of = date.fromisoformat(as_of).isoformat()
    inputs = load_inputs(praxis_root)
    rules_bytes = default_rules_bytes() if rules_bytes is None else rules_bytes
    rules_sha = sha256_hex(rules_bytes)
    snapshot = CompanySnapshot.from_tsv(companies) if companies else None
    snap_digest = snapshot.digest if snapshot else "none"
    run_key = _run_key(inputs, rules_sha, snap_digest, as_of)
    result = BuildResult(skipped=False, run_key=run_key)

    prior = _read_manifest(out_dir)
    if prior and any(r["kind"] == "run_key" and r["sha256"] == run_key for r in prior):
        if not verify_outputs(out_dir, prior):
            result.skipped = True
            return result

    rules = load_rules(rules_bytes, _taxonomy_codes(inputs))
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    findings: list[dict] = []
    context: list[dict] = []
    sources: list[dict] = []
    for inp in inputs:
        if not inp.present or inp.spec.role not in (GROUND, CONTEXT, SOURCES):
            continue
        rows = _cached_extract(out_dir, inp, as_of, result)
        {GROUND: findings, CONTEXT: context, SOURCES: sources}[inp.spec.role].extend(rows)

    identities = resolve_many([_reference(f) for f in findings], snapshot)
    candidates = build_candidates(findings, rules, identities, _sdg_by_code(inputs), as_of)

    matched: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for f in findings:
        matched[f["finding_id"]] = {r.rule_id for r in rules if r.map == f["source_map"] and r.matches(f)}
    findings_out = sorted(
        ({**f, "matched_rules": ";".join(sorted(matched[f["finding_id"]]))} for f in findings),
        key=lambda f: f["finding_id"],
    )

    ident_rows: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for f in findings:
        ident = identities[_reference(f)]
        row = ident_rows.setdefault(
            f["developer"],
            {
                "developer": f["developer"],
                "identity_status": ident.status,
                "identity_tier": ident.tier,
                "company_id": ident.company_id or "",
                **{k: ident.keys.get(k, "") for k in KEY_COLUMNS},
                "warnings": ";".join(ident.warnings),
                "finding_count": 0,
            },
        )
        row["finding_count"] += 1

    outputs = {
        "candidates.tsv": to_tsv(CANDIDATE_COLUMNS, candidates),
        "findings.tsv": to_tsv((*FINDING_COLUMNS, "matched_rules"), findings_out),
        "context.tsv": to_tsv(CONTEXT_COLUMNS, sorted(context, key=lambda r: r["context_id"])),
        "sources.tsv": to_tsv(SOURCE_COLUMNS, sorted(sources, key=lambda r: r["source_candidate_id"])),
        "identity.tsv": to_tsv(IDENTITY_COLUMNS, [ident_rows[k] for k in sorted(ident_rows)]),
    }
    for name, data in outputs.items():
        (out_dir / name).write_bytes(data)
    if parquet:
        for stem in ("candidates", "findings"):
            _write_parquet(out_dir / f"{stem}.tsv", out_dir / f"{stem}.parquet")

    manifest: list[dict] = [
        {"kind": "param", "name": "feed_version", "sha256": "", "git_blob": "", "rows": "", "note": FEED_VERSION},
        {"kind": "param", "name": "as_of", "sha256": "", "git_blob": "", "rows": "", "note": as_of},
        {"kind": "rules", "name": "dark/exclusions_feed/rules.tsv", "sha256": rules_sha, "git_blob": "", "rows": len(rules), "note": ""},
        {
            "kind": "snapshot",
            "name": "research.companies" if snapshot else "none",
            "sha256": snapshot.digest if snapshot else "",
            "git_blob": "",
            "rows": len(snapshot.rows) if snapshot else 0,
            "note": "offline snapshot" if snapshot else "no snapshot: identity unresolved",
        },
    ]
    for inp in inputs:
        manifest.append(
            {
                "kind": "input",
                "name": inp.spec.relpath,
                "sha256": inp.sha256,
                "git_blob": inp.git_blob,
                "rows": "",
                "note": f"{inp.spec.role}:{inp.spec.map}" + ("" if inp.present else " absent"),
            }
        )
    for name in sorted(p.name for p in out_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name not in ("manifest.tsv", "state.tsv")):
        data = (out_dir / name).read_bytes()
        rows = data.count(b"\n") - 1 if name.endswith(".tsv") else ""
        manifest.append({"kind": "output", "name": name, "sha256": sha256_hex(data), "git_blob": "", "rows": rows, "note": ""})
    manifest.append({"kind": "run_key", "name": "", "sha256": run_key, "git_blob": "", "rows": "", "note": ""})
    cols = ("kind", "name", "sha256", "git_blob", "rows", "note")
    (out_dir / "manifest.tsv").write_bytes(to_tsv(cols, manifest))

    state = [
        {"input": i.spec.relpath, "sha256": i.sha256, "role": i.spec.role}
        for i in inputs
        if i.present and i.spec.role in (GROUND, CONTEXT, SOURCES)
    ]
    (out_dir / "state.tsv").write_bytes(to_tsv(("input", "sha256", "role"), state))

    result.counts = {
        "findings": len(findings_out),
        "candidates": len(candidates),
        "context": len(context),
        "sources": len(sources),
        "developers": len(ident_rows),
    }
    for c in candidates:
        result.candidates_by_code[c["proposed_code"]] = result.candidates_by_code.get(c["proposed_code"], 0) + 1
    for r in ident_rows.values():
        result.identity_by_status[r["identity_status"]] = result.identity_by_status.get(r["identity_status"], 0) + 1
    return result


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ verify


def verify_outputs(out_dir: Path, manifest: list[dict] | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Re-hash every output against the manifest."""
    manifest = _read_manifest(out_dir) if manifest is None else manifest
    problems = []
    for r in manifest:
        if r["kind"] != "output":
            continue
        p = out_dir / r["name"]
        if not p.is_file():
            problems.append(f"missing output {r['name']}")
        elif sha256_hex(p.read_bytes()) != r["sha256"]:
            problems.append(f"digest mismatch {r['name']}")
    if not manifest:
        problems.append("no manifest")
    return problems


def verify(out_dir: Path, praxis_root: Path | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Check outputs, ids, quote digests, grounds, and (optionally) input drift.

    With ``praxis_root``, each candidate's quote is re-found verbatim in the
    source row whose digest it cites.
    """
    manifest = _read_manifest(out_dir)
    problems = verify_outputs(out_dir, manifest)
    if problems:
        return problems
    cands = from_tsv((out_dir / "candidates.tsv").read_bytes())
    for c in cands:
        cid = c["candidate_id"]
        if sha256_hex(c["quote"].encode("utf-8")) != c["quote_sha256"]:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: quote_sha256 mismatch")
        if candidate_id(c["company_key"], c["proposed_code"], c["evidence_url"], c["quote_sha256"]) != cid:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: candidate_id does not recompute")
        if c["source_map"] in CONTEXT_MAPS or c["source_map"] not in GROUND_MAPS:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: grounded on non-ground map {c['source_map']}")
        if c["review_status"] != REVIEW_STATUS:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: review_status {c['review_status']!r}")
        if c["basis"] == "proposal" and not c["witness"]:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: proposal without witness")
    if praxis_root is not None:
        recorded = {r["name"]: r["sha256"] for r in manifest if r["kind"] == "input"}
        loaded = {i.spec.relpath: i for i in load_inputs(praxis_root)}
        for rel, sha in recorded.items():
            if loaded[rel].sha256 != sha:
                problems.append(f"input drift {rel}: manifest {sha[:12] or 'absent'} now {loaded[rel].sha256[:12] or 'absent'}")
        for c in cands:
            inp = loaded[c["source_file"]]
            rows = {sha: row for row, sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]} if inp.present else {}
            row = rows.get(c["source_row_sha256"])
            if row is None:
                problems.append(f"{c['candidate_id']}: source row not found in {c['source_file']}")
            elif c["quote"] != row.get("quote") or c["evidence_url"] != row.get("evidence_url"):
                problems.append(f"{c['candidate_id']}: quote/url not verbatim in source row")
    return problems

"""Topology findings -> candidate exclusion evidence lines (staged, never inserted).

Pure pipeline over pinned bytes. Same inputs + same ``as_of`` -> byte-identical
outputs: no clock, host, absolute path or random id enters any file.

Outputs (all sorted by their id column):

* ``candidates.tsv`` / ``.parquet`` — one line per (company, code, url, quote),
  ``review_status = needs_cio_review``. Only ground maps, only through a rule.
* ``findings.tsv`` / ``.parquet`` — every company-level ground finding, with the
  rules it matched (empty when none). The review queue for unmapped evidence.
* ``context.tsv`` — benefit claims, author positions, AI centres. Never grounds.
* ``sources.tsv`` — bodies registry rows as ``exclusions.sources`` candidates.
* ``identity.tsv`` — one row per unique developer reference and its resolution.
* ``manifest.tsv`` — input digests, rules/snapshot digests, as_of, output digests.
* ``state.tsv`` — processed input digests -> content-addressed extraction cache.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from importlib import resources
from pathlib import Path

from dark.security_master import Reference

from dark.exclusions_feed.identity import (
    RESOLVED,
    CompanySnapshot,
    Identity,
    resolve_many,
)
from dark.exclusions_feed.inputs import (
    CONTEXT,
    CONTEXT_MAPS,
    GROUND,
    GROUND_MAPS,
    INPUTS,
    SOURCES,
    LoadedInput,
    load_inputs,
    parse_tsv,
    sha256_hex,
)

#: Bump when extraction or output shape changes; part of the run key and cache key.
FEED_VERSION = "1"
REVIEW_STATUS = "needs_cio_review"
KEY_COLUMNS = ("cik", "lei", "figi", "isin", "ticker")

FINDING_COLUMNS = (
    "finding_id",
    "source_map",
    "source_file",
    "input_sha256",
    "source_row_sha256",
    "developer",
    "developer_field",

    "quote",
    "quote_sha256",

    *KEY_COLUMNS,
)
CANDIDATE_COLUMNS = (
    "candidate_id",
    "company_key",
    "identity_status",
    "identity_tier",
    "company_id",
    "company_id_candidate",
    *KEY_COLUMNS,

    "proposed_code",

)
CONTEXT_COLUMNS = (

    "source_map",
    "source_file",
    "input_sha256",
    "source_row_sha256",
    "subject",
    "url",
    "quote",
    "quote_sha256",
    "fields_json",
    "as_of",
)
SOURCE_COLUMNS = (
    "source_candidate_id",
    "source_key",

    "source_type",

    "url_status",
    "license",
    "domain",
    "jurisdiction",
    "taxonomy_artifact",

    "source_row_sha256",

)
IDENTITY_COLUMNS = (
    "developer",
    "identity_status",
    "identity_tier",
    "company_id",
    *KEY_COLUMNS,
    "warnings",
    "finding_count",

RULE_COLUMNS = (
    "rule_id",
    "map",

    "op",
    "value",
    "sub_category_code",
    "basis",
    "witness",
    "approved_by",
    "rationale",

# --------------------------------------------------------------------- TSV io


def to_tsv(columns: tuple[str, ...], rows: list[dict]) -> bytes:
    """Serialize rows; a tab or newline in a value is an error, never rewritten."""
    out = ["\t".join(columns)]
    for row in rows:
        cells = []
        for c in columns:
            v = row.get(c)
            s = "" if v is None else str(v)
            if any(ch in s for ch in "\t\n\r"):
                raise ValueError(f"{c}: value contains a tab or newline")
            cells.append(s)
        out.append("\t".join(cells))
    return ("\n".join(out) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def from_tsv(data: bytes) -> list[dict]:
    return [r for r, _ in parse_tsv(data)[1]]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- rules


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rule:
    rule_id: str
    map: str
    field: str
    op: str
    value: str
    code: str
    basis: str
    witness: str
    approved_by: str

    def matches(self, finding: dict) -> bool:
        cell = finding.get(self.field) or ""
        if self.op == "eq":
            return cell == self.value
        pattern = r"(?<![0-9A-Za-z])" + re.escape(self.value) + r"(?![0-9A-Za-z])"
        return re.search(pattern, cell, flags=re.IGNORECASE) is not None


def default_rules_bytes() -> bytes:
    return resources.files("dark.exclusions_feed").joinpath("rules.tsv").read_bytes()


def load_rules(data: bytes, taxonomy_codes: frozenset[str]) -> list[Rule]:
    """Parse and validate rules. Fails closed on any rule that could misfire."""
    rules: list[Rule] = []
    for r in from_tsv(data):
        rid = r["rule_id"]
        if r["map"] in CONTEXT_MAPS or r["map"] not in GROUND_MAPS:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: map {r['map']!r} is not a ground map")
        if r["sub_category_code"] not in taxonomy_codes:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: {r['sub_category_code']!r} not in taxonomy")
        if r["op"] not in ("eq", "term"):
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: unknown op {r['op']!r}")
        if r["basis"] == "computed" and not r["approved_by"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: basis=computed requires approved_by")
        if r["basis"] not in ("computed", "proposal"):
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: basis must be computed or proposal")
        if r["basis"] == "proposal" and not r["witness"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{rid}: a proposal names its witness")
        rules.append(
            Rule(
                rid,
                r["map"],
                r["field"],
                r["op"],
                r["value"],
                r["sub_category_code"],
                r["basis"],
                r["witness"],
                r["approved_by"],
            )
        )
    return sorted(rules, key=lambda x: x.rule_id)


# --------------------------------------------------------------- extraction


def _split_developers(raw: str) -> list[str]:
    """The map's own delimiter: ``A; B`` names two developers."""
    return [p.strip() for p in raw.split(";") if p.strip()]


def extract_findings(inp: LoadedInput) -> list[dict]:
    """One finding per (row, developer) of a ground map."""
    out = []
    for row, row_sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]:
        for dev in _split_developers(row.get("developer", "")):
            quote = row.get("quote", "")
            f = {
                "source_map": inp.spec.map,
                "source_file": inp.spec.relpath,
                "input_sha256": inp.sha256,
                "source_row_sha256": row_sha,
                "developer": dev,
                "developer_field": row.get("developer", ""),
                "country": row.get("country", ""),
                "model": row.get("model", ""),
                "method_id": row.get("method_id", ""),
                "evidence_url": row.get("evidence_url", ""),
                "evidence_pin": row.get("evidence_pin", ""),
                "quote": quote,
                "quote_sha256": sha256_hex(quote.encode("utf-8")) if quote else "",
                "status": row.get("status", ""),
                "source_witness": row.get("witness", ""),
                **{k: row.get(k, "") for k in KEY_COLUMNS},
            }
            f["finding_id"] = sha256_hex(f"{row_sha}\t{dev}".encode())
            out.append(f)
    return out


_SUBJECT_FIELDS = ("developer", "company", "body_id", "author", "name", "id")
_URL_FIELDS = ("evidence_url", "url", "source_url")


def extract_context(inp: LoadedInput, as_of: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Context rows are carried whole (``fields_json``); they ground nothing."""
    out = []
    for row, row_sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]:
        quote = row.get("quote", "")
        out.append(
            {
                "context_id": sha256_hex(f"{inp.spec.relpath}\t{row_sha}".encode()),
                "source_map": inp.spec.map,
                "source_file": inp.spec.relpath,
                "input_sha256": inp.sha256,
                "source_row_sha256": row_sha,
                "subject": next((row[f] for f in _SUBJECT_FIELDS if row.get(f)), ""),
                "url": next((row[f] for f in _URL_FIELDS if row.get(f)), ""),
                "quote": quote,
                "quote_sha256": sha256_hex(quote.encode("utf-8")) if quote else "",
                "fields_json": json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False),
                "as_of": as_of,
            }
        )
    return out


def extract_sources(inp: LoadedInput, as_of: str) -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    for row, row_sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]:
        raw_url = row.get("artifact_url", "")
        url_status, _, url = raw_url.partition(":") if raw_url.startswith("unverified:") else ("", "", raw_url)
        key = f"praxis-body:{row.get('id', '')}"
        out.append(
            {
                "source_candidate_id": sha256_hex(f"{key}\t{url}".encode()),
                "source_key": key,
                "source_name": row.get("name", ""),
                "source_type": row.get("kind", ""),
                "url": url,
                "url_status": url_status or ("present" if url else "absent"),
                "license": row.get("terms_verdict", ""),
                "domain": row.get("domain_claimed", ""),
                "jurisdiction": row.get("jurisdiction", ""),
                "taxonomy_artifact": row.get("taxonomy_artifact", ""),
                "terms_url": row.get("terms_url", ""),
                "fetch_status": row.get("fetch_status", ""),
                "source_witness": row.get("witness", ""),
                "notes": row.get("notes", ""),
                "input_sha256": inp.sha256,
                "source_row_sha256": row_sha,
                "review_status": REVIEW_STATUS,
                "as_of": as_of,
            }
        )
    return out


# -------------------------------------------------------------- candidates


def candidate_id(company_key: str, code: str, evidence_url: str, quote_sha256: str) -> str:
    return sha256_hex("\t".join((company_key, code, evidence_url, quote_sha256)).encode())


def _reference(f: dict) -> Reference:
    return Reference(name=f["developer"], **{k: (f.get(k) or None) for k in KEY_COLUMNS})


def build_candidates(
    findings: list[dict],
    rules: list[Rule],
    identities: dict[Reference, Identity],
    sdg_by_code: dict[str, str],
    as_of: str,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Rule matches on verified, quoted findings -> deduplicated candidate lines."""
    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for f in findings:
        if not f["status"].startswith("verified:") or not f["quote"]:
            continue
        ident = identities[_reference(f)]
        ckey = ident.company_key(f["developer"])
        for rule in rules:
            if rule.map != f["source_map"] or not rule.matches(f):
                continue
            cid = candidate_id(ckey, rule.code, f["evidence_url"], f["quote_sha256"])
            if cid in by_id:
                prev = by_id[cid]
                prev["rule_ids"] = ";".join(sorted({*prev["rule_ids"].split(";"), rule.rule_id}))
                continue
            resolved = ident.status == RESOLVED
            by_id[cid] = {
                "candidate_id": cid,
                "company_key": ckey,
                "identity_status": ident.status,
                "identity_tier": ident.tier,
                "company_id": ident.company_id if resolved else "",
                "company_id_candidate": "" if resolved else (ident.company_id or ""),
                **{k: ident.keys.get(k, "") for k in KEY_COLUMNS},
                "developer": f["developer"],
                "proposed_code": rule.code,
                "basis": rule.basis,
                "witness": rule.witness if rule.basis == "proposal" else "",
                "approved_by": rule.approved_by,
                "rule_ids": rule.rule_id,
                "sdg_computed": sdg_by_code.get(rule.code, ""),
                "evidence_url": f["evidence_url"],
                "evidence_pin": f["evidence_pin"],
                "quote": f["quote"],
                "quote_sha256": f["quote_sha256"],
                "source_map": f["source_map"],
                "source_file": f["source_file"],
                "input_sha256": f["input_sha256"],
                "source_row_sha256": f["source_row_sha256"],
                "finding_id": f["finding_id"],
                "review_status": REVIEW_STATUS,
                "as_of": as_of,
            }
    return [by_id[k] for k in sorted(by_id)]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- build


@dataclass
class BuildResult:
    skipped: bool
    run_key: str
    counts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    candidates_by_code: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    identity_by_status: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    extracted: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    cached: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def _taxonomy_codes(inputs: list[LoadedInput]) -> frozenset[str]:
    tax = next(i for i in inputs if i.spec.map == "taxonomy")
    return frozenset(r["sub_category_code"] for r in json.loads(tax.data))


def _sdg_by_code(inputs: list[LoadedInput]) -> dict[str, str]:
    comp = next(i for i in inputs if i.spec.relpath.endswith("exclusions-sdg/computed.tsv"))
    if not comp.present:
        return {}
    acc: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for r in from_tsv(comp.data):
        acc.setdefault(r["category"], set()).add(r["sdg_code"])
    return {k: ";".join(sorted(v, key=lambda s: [int(p) for p in s.split(".") if p.isdigit()])) for k, v in acc.items()}


def _run_key(inputs: list[LoadedInput], rules_sha: str, snap_digest: str, as_of: str) -> str:
    parts = [f"v{FEED_VERSION}", as_of, rules_sha, snap_digest]
    parts += [f"{i.spec.relpath}={i.sha256 or 'absent'}" for i in inputs]
    return sha256_hex("\n".join(parts).encode())


def _read_manifest(out_dir: Path) -> list[dict]:
    p = out_dir / "manifest.tsv"
    return from_tsv(p.read_bytes()) if p.is_file() else []


def _cached_extract(out_dir: Path, inp: LoadedInput, as_of: str, result: BuildResult) -> list[dict]:
    """Content-addressed: an input whose digest was processed is not re-parsed."""
    role = inp.spec.role
    columns = {GROUND: FINDING_COLUMNS, CONTEXT: CONTEXT_COLUMNS, SOURCES: SOURCE_COLUMNS}[role]
    # Context/sources rows carry as_of, so it is part of their cache key.
    suffix = "" if role == GROUND else f"-{as_of}"
    cache = out_dir / ".cache" / f"{role}-v{FEED_VERSION}-{inp.sha256}{suffix}.tsv"
    if cache.is_file():
        result.cached.append(inp.spec.relpath)
        return from_tsv(cache.read_bytes())
    if role == GROUND:
        rows = extract_findings(inp)
    elif role == CONTEXT:
        rows = extract_context(inp, as_of)
    else:
        rows = extract_sources(inp, as_of)
    cache.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cache.write_bytes(to_tsv(columns, rows))
    result.extracted.append(inp.spec.relpath)
    return rows


def _write_parquet(tsv: Path, parquet: Path) -> bool:
    """Columnar copy via DuckDB (a declared dark-core dependency). Single thread."""
    try:
        import duckdb
    except ModuleNotFoundError:  # pragma: no cover - duckdb is a core dep
        return False
    con = duckdb.connect()
    try:
        con.execute("SET threads TO 1")
        con.execute(
            "COPY (SELECT * FROM read_csv(?, delim='\t', header=true, all_varchar=true, "
            "quote='', escape='', auto_detect=false, columns=?) ) "
            "TO '" + str(parquet).replace("'", "''") + "' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)",
            [str(tsv), {c: "VARCHAR" for c in tsv.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n", 1)[0].split("\t")}],
        )
    finally:
        con.close()
    return True


def build(
    praxis_root: Path,
    out_dir: Path,
    as_of: str,
    *,
    companies: Path | None = None,
    rules_bytes: bytes | None = None,
    parquet: bool = True,
) -> BuildResult:
    """Build the staged outputs. Writes only under ``out_dir``. No DB access."""
    as_of = date.fromisoformat(as_of).isoformat()
    inputs = load_inputs(praxis_root)
    rules_bytes = default_rules_bytes() if rules_bytes is None else rules_bytes
    rules_sha = sha256_hex(rules_bytes)
    snapshot = CompanySnapshot.from_tsv(companies) if companies else None
    snap_digest = snapshot.digest if snapshot else "none"
    run_key = _run_key(inputs, rules_sha, snap_digest, as_of)
    result = BuildResult(skipped=False, run_key=run_key)

    prior = _read_manifest(out_dir)
    if prior and any(r["kind"] == "run_key" and r["sha256"] == run_key for r in prior):
        if not verify_outputs(out_dir, prior):
            result.skipped = True
            return result

    rules = load_rules(rules_bytes, _taxonomy_codes(inputs))
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    findings: list[dict] = []
    context: list[dict] = []
    sources: list[dict] = []
    for inp in inputs:
        if not inp.present or inp.spec.role not in (GROUND, CONTEXT, SOURCES):
            continue
        rows = _cached_extract(out_dir, inp, as_of, result)
        {GROUND: findings, CONTEXT: context, SOURCES: sources}[inp.spec.role].extend(rows)

    identities = resolve_many([_reference(f) for f in findings], snapshot)
    candidates = build_candidates(findings, rules, identities, _sdg_by_code(inputs), as_of)

    matched: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for f in findings:
        matched[f["finding_id"]] = {r.rule_id for r in rules if r.map == f["source_map"] and r.matches(f)}
    findings_out = sorted(
        ({**f, "matched_rules": ";".join(sorted(matched[f["finding_id"]]))} for f in findings),
        key=lambda f: f["finding_id"],
    )

    ident_rows: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for f in findings:
        ident = identities[_reference(f)]
        row = ident_rows.setdefault(
            f["developer"],
            {
                "developer": f["developer"],
                "identity_status": ident.status,
                "identity_tier": ident.tier,
                "company_id": ident.company_id or "",
                **{k: ident.keys.get(k, "") for k in KEY_COLUMNS},
                "warnings": ";".join(ident.warnings),
                "finding_count": 0,
            },
        )
        row["finding_count"] += 1

    outputs = {
        "candidates.tsv": to_tsv(CANDIDATE_COLUMNS, candidates),
        "findings.tsv": to_tsv((*FINDING_COLUMNS, "matched_rules"), findings_out),
        "context.tsv": to_tsv(CONTEXT_COLUMNS, sorted(context, key=lambda r: r["context_id"])),
        "sources.tsv": to_tsv(SOURCE_COLUMNS, sorted(sources, key=lambda r: r["source_candidate_id"])),
        "identity.tsv": to_tsv(IDENTITY_COLUMNS, [ident_rows[k] for k in sorted(ident_rows)]),
    }
    for name, data in outputs.items():
        (out_dir / name).write_bytes(data)
    if parquet:
        for stem in ("candidates", "findings"):
            _write_parquet(out_dir / f"{stem}.tsv", out_dir / f"{stem}.parquet")

    manifest: list[dict] = [
        {"kind": "param", "name": "feed_version", "sha256": "", "git_blob": "", "rows": "", "note": FEED_VERSION},
        {"kind": "param", "name": "as_of", "sha256": "", "git_blob": "", "rows": "", "note": as_of},
        {"kind": "rules", "name": "dark/exclusions_feed/rules.tsv", "sha256": rules_sha, "git_blob": "", "rows": len(rules), "note": ""},
        {
            "kind": "snapshot",
            "name": "research.companies" if snapshot else "none",
            "sha256": snapshot.digest if snapshot else "",
            "git_blob": "",
            "rows": len(snapshot.rows) if snapshot else 0,
            "note": "offline snapshot" if snapshot else "no snapshot: identity unresolved",
        },
    ]
    for inp in inputs:
        manifest.append(
            {
                "kind": "input",
                "name": inp.spec.relpath,
                "sha256": inp.sha256,
                "git_blob": inp.git_blob,
                "rows": "",
                "note": f"{inp.spec.role}:{inp.spec.map}" + ("" if inp.present else " absent"),
            }
        )
    for name in sorted(p.name for p in out_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name not in ("manifest.tsv", "state.tsv")):
        data = (out_dir / name).read_bytes()
        rows = data.count(b"\n") - 1 if name.endswith(".tsv") else ""
        manifest.append({"kind": "output", "name": name, "sha256": sha256_hex(data), "git_blob": "", "rows": rows, "note": ""})
    manifest.append({"kind": "run_key", "name": "", "sha256": run_key, "git_blob": "", "rows": "", "note": ""})
    cols = ("kind", "name", "sha256", "git_blob", "rows", "note")
    (out_dir / "manifest.tsv").write_bytes(to_tsv(cols, manifest))

    state = [
        {"input": i.spec.relpath, "sha256": i.sha256, "role": i.spec.role}
        for i in inputs
        if i.present and i.spec.role in (GROUND, CONTEXT, SOURCES)
    ]
    (out_dir / "state.tsv").write_bytes(to_tsv(("input", "sha256", "role"), state))

    result.counts = {
        "findings": len(findings_out),
        "candidates": len(candidates),
        "context": len(context),
        "sources": len(sources),
        "developers": len(ident_rows),
    }
    for c in candidates:
        result.candidates_by_code[c["proposed_code"]] = result.candidates_by_code.get(c["proposed_code"], 0) + 1
    for r in ident_rows.values():
        result.identity_by_status[r["identity_status"]] = result.identity_by_status.get(r["identity_status"], 0) + 1
    return result


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ verify


def verify_outputs(out_dir: Path, manifest: list[dict] | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Re-hash every output against the manifest."""
    manifest = _read_manifest(out_dir) if manifest is None else manifest
    problems = []
    for r in manifest:
        if r["kind"] != "output":
            continue
        p = out_dir / r["name"]
        if not p.is_file():
            problems.append(f"missing output {r['name']}")
        elif sha256_hex(p.read_bytes()) != r["sha256"]:
            problems.append(f"digest mismatch {r['name']}")
    if not manifest:
        problems.append("no manifest")
    return problems


def verify(out_dir: Path, praxis_root: Path | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Check outputs, ids, quote digests, grounds, and (optionally) input drift.

    With ``praxis_root``, each candidate's quote is re-found verbatim in the
    source row whose digest it cites.
    """
    manifest = _read_manifest(out_dir)
    problems = verify_outputs(out_dir, manifest)
    if problems:
        return problems
    cands = from_tsv((out_dir / "candidates.tsv").read_bytes())
    for c in cands:
        cid = c["candidate_id"]
        if sha256_hex(c["quote"].encode("utf-8")) != c["quote_sha256"]:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: quote_sha256 mismatch")
        if candidate_id(c["company_key"], c["proposed_code"], c["evidence_url"], c["quote_sha256"]) != cid:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: candidate_id does not recompute")
        if c["source_map"] in CONTEXT_MAPS or c["source_map"] not in GROUND_MAPS:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: grounded on non-ground map {c['source_map']}")
        if c["review_status"] != REVIEW_STATUS:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: review_status {c['review_status']!r}")
        if c["basis"] == "proposal" and not c["witness"]:
            problems.append(f"{cid}: proposal without witness")
    if praxis_root is not None:
        recorded = {r["name"]: r["sha256"] for r in manifest if r["kind"] == "input"}
        loaded = {i.spec.relpath: i for i in load_inputs(praxis_root)}
        for rel, sha in recorded.items():
            if loaded[rel].sha256 != sha:
                problems.append(f"input drift {rel}: manifest {sha[:12] or 'absent'} now {loaded[rel].sha256[:12] or 'absent'}")
        for c in cands:
            inp = loaded[c["source_file"]]
            rows = {sha: row for row, sha in parse_tsv(inp.data)[1]} if inp.present else {}
            row = rows.get(c["source_row_sha256"])
            if row is None:
                problems.append(f"{c['candidate_id']}: source row not found in {c['source_file']}")
            elif c["quote"] != row.get("quote") or c["evidence_url"] != row.get("evidence_url"):
                problems.append(f"{c['candidate_id']}: quote/url not verbatim in source row")
    return problems


__all__ = [
    "BuildResult",
    "INPUTS",
    "Rule",
    "build",
    "build_candidates",
    "candidate_id",
    "extract_context",
    "extract_findings",
    "extract_sources",
    "load_rules",
    "verify",
]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stage candidate exclusion evidence from pinned Praxis topology maps.

Thin CLI over :mod:`dark.exclusions_feed`. No database access of any kind:
output is staged for Sloane's review; nothing is inserted into exclusions.*.

Usage (from the repo root):
    PYTHONPATH=packages/python python3 scripts/exclusions/exclusions_feed.py \\
        build --praxis ../praxis --as-of 2026-11-05 --out docs/exclusions/candidates/topologies
    PYTHONPATH=packages/python python3 scripts/exclusions/exclusions_feed.py \\
        verify --praxis ../praxis --out docs/exclusions/candidates/topologies

``--companies`` takes an offline research.companies snapshot TSV
(columns: dark.exclusions_feed.identity.SNAPSHOT_COLUMNS; query: SNAPSHOT_SQL).
Without it every developer is reported ``no_snapshot``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from dark.exclusions_feed import build, verify


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n", 1)[0])
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    b = sub.add_parser("build")
    b.add_argument("--praxis", type=Path, required=True, help="Praxis checkout root")
    b.add_argument("--as-of", required=True, help="YYYY-MM-DD, recorded in outputs")
    b.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    b.add_argument("--companies", type=Path, help="offline research.companies snapshot TSV")
    b.add_argument("--no-parquet", action="store_true")
    v = sub.add_parser("verify")
    v.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    v.add_argument("--praxis", type=Path, help="also re-find quotes in pinned inputs")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    if args.cmd == "build":
        r = build(args.praxis, args.out, args.as_of, companies=args.companies, parquet=not args.no_parquet)
        if r.skipped:
            print(f"unchanged run_key={r.run_key[:16]}; outputs verified, nothing rebuilt")
            return 0
        print(f"run_key={r.run_key[:16]} extracted={len(r.extracted)} cached={len(r.cached)}")
        for k, n in sorted(r.counts.items()):
            print(f"  {k}: {n}")
        for k, n in sorted(r.candidates_by_code.items()):
            print(f"  candidates[{k}]: {n}")
        for k, n in sorted(r.identity_by_status.items()):
            print(f"  identity[{k}]: {n}")
        return 0

    problems = verify(args.out, args.praxis)
    for p in problems:
        print(p, file=sys.stderr)
    print("verify: ok" if not problems else f"verify: {len(problems)} problem(s)")
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stage candidate exclusion evidence from pinned Praxis topology maps.

Thin CLI over :mod:`dark.exclusions_feed`. No database access of any kind:
output is staged for Sloane's review; nothing is inserted into exclusions.*.

Usage (from the repo root):
    PYTHONPATH=packages/python python3 scripts/exclusions/exclusions_feed.py \\
        build --praxis ../praxis --as-of 2026-11-05 --out docs/exclusions/candidates/topologies
    PYTHONPATH=packages/python python3 scripts/exclusions/exclusions_feed.py \\
        verify --praxis ../praxis --out docs/exclusions/candidates/topologies

``--companies`` takes an offline research.companies snapshot TSV
(columns: dark.exclusions_feed.identity.SNAPSHOT_COLUMNS; query: SNAPSHOT_SQL).
Without it every developer is reported ``no_snapshot``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from dark.exclusions_feed import build, verify


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n", 1)[0])
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    b = sub.add_parser("build")
    b.add_argument("--praxis", type=Path, required=True, help="Praxis checkout root")
    b.add_argument("--as-of", required=True, help="YYYY-MM-DD, recorded in outputs")
    b.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    b.add_argument("--companies", type=Path, help="offline research.companies snapshot TSV")
    b.add_argument("--no-parquet", action="store_true")
    v = sub.add_parser("verify")
    v.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    v.add_argument("--praxis", type=Path, help="also re-find quotes in pinned inputs")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    if args.cmd == "build":
        r = build(args.praxis, args.out, args.as_of, companies=args.companies, parquet=not args.no_parquet)
        if r.skipped:
            print(f"unchanged run_key={r.run_key[:16]}; outputs verified, nothing rebuilt")
            return 0
        print(f"run_key={r.run_key[:16]} extracted={len(r.extracted)} cached={len(r.cached)}")
        for k, n in sorted(r.counts.items()):
            print(f"  {k}: {n}")
        for k, n in sorted(r.candidates_by_code.items()):
            print(f"  candidates[{k}]: {n}")
        for k, n in sorted(r.identity_by_status.items()):
            print(f"  identity[{k}]: {n}")
        return 0

    problems = verify(args.out, args.praxis)
    for p in problems:
        print(p, file=sys.stderr)
    print("verify: ok" if not problems else f"verify: {len(problems)} problem(s)")
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""dark.exclusions_feed — real Praxis row excerpts, no database."""

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from dark.exclusions_feed import build, verify
from dark.exclusions_feed.feed import default_rules_bytes, from_tsv, load_rules
from dark.exclusions_feed.identity import (
    NAME_CANDIDATE,
    RESOLVED,
    SNAPSHOT_COLUMNS,
    CompanySnapshot,
    resolve_many,
)
from dark.exclusions_feed.inputs import git_blob_sha1
from dark.security_master import Reference

FIX = Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures" / "exclusions_feed"
AS_OF = "2026-11-05"
WITNESS = "llm:claude-opus-5-5 prompt=unrecorded"


@pytest.fixture
def praxis(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path / "praxis"
    shutil.copytree(FIX / "praxis", root)
    return root


def _rows(out: Path, name: str) -> list[dict]:
    return from_tsv((out / name).read_bytes())


def test_candidates_from_real_rows(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    r = build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    cands = _rows(out, "candidates.tsv")
    assert sorted(c["developer"] for c in cands) == [
        "Hugging Face",
        "Microsoft",
        "Technology Innovation Institute",
    ]
    for c in cands:
        assert c["proposed_code"] == "data_privacy"
        assert c["basis"] == "proposal" and c["witness"] == WITNESS
        assert c["review_status"] == "needs_cio_review"
        assert c["identity_status"] == "no_snapshot"
        assert c["company_key"] == f"name:{c['developer']}"
        assert c["as_of"] == AS_OF
    assert r.candidates_by_code == {"data_privacy": 3}
    # Unverified rows (terms-barred, no quote) never become candidates.
    assert not any(c["developer"] == "Anthropic" for c in cands)
    # "A; B" names two developers.
    devs = {f["developer"] for f in _rows(out, "findings.tsv")}
    assert {"Zhipu AI", "Tsinghua University"} <= devs
    assert verify(out, praxis) == []


def test_byte_identical_rebuild(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    a, b = tmp_path / "a", tmp_path / "b"
    build(praxis, a, AS_OF)
    build(praxis, b, AS_OF)
    names = sorted(p.name for p in a.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    assert "candidates.parquet" in names
    assert names == sorted(p.name for p in b.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    for n in names:
        assert (a / n).read_bytes() == (b / n).read_bytes(), n


def test_incremental_skip_and_cache(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    first = build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    assert not first.skipped and first.cached == []
    assert build(praxis, out, AS_OF).skipped
    later = build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06")
    assert "resources/topologies/training-methods/uses.tsv" in later.cached
    (out / "candidates.tsv").write_bytes(b"tampered\n")
    assert not build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06").skipped  # bad outputs force a rebuild


def test_benefit_claims_are_context_never_grounds(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    claims = praxis / "resources/topologies/ai-benefit-claims/claims.tsv"
    claims.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(FIX / "ai-benefit-claims-manifest-excerpt.tsv", claims)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    ctx = [c for c in _rows(out, "context.tsv") if c["source_map"] == "ai-benefit-claims"]
    assert len(ctx) == 2
    assert all(c["source_map"] == "training-methods" for c in _rows(out, "candidates.tsv"))

    codes = frozenset({"data_privacy"})
    bad = default_rules_bytes().replace(b"R001\ttraining-methods", b"R001\tai-benefit-claims")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not a ground map"):
        load_rules(bad, codes)


def test_rule_validation_fails_closed() -> None:
    codes = frozenset({"data_privacy"})
    rules = default_rules_bytes()
    assert len(load_rules(rules, codes)) == 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="approved_by"):
        load_rules(rules.replace(b"\tproposal\t", b"\tcomputed\t", 1), codes)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not in taxonomy"):
        load_rules(rules, frozenset({"surveillance_tech"}))


def test_sources_from_bodies(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    srcs = _rows(out, "sources.tsv")
    assert len(srcs) == 10
    aasb = next(s for s in srcs if s["source_key"] == "praxis-body:aasb")
    assert aasb["url"] == "https://www.aasb.gov.au/" and aasb["url_status"] == "unverified"
    assert all(s["review_status"] == "needs_cio_review" for s in srcs)


def test_verify_catches_tampered_quote(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    p = out / "candidates.tsv"
    p.write_bytes(p.read_bytes().replace(b"web data", b"web DATA", 1))
    assert any("digest mismatch" in x for x in verify(out, praxis))


def _synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    # SYNTHETIC research.companies rows: no live snapshot is available offline.
    rows = [
        ["101", "ZZZQ", "", "", "", "", "", "stock", "", "Microsoft", ""],
        ["102", "QQQZ", "", "0000000102", "", "", "", "stock", "", "Synthetic Co", ""],
    ]
    p = tmp_path / "companies.tsv"
    p.write_text("\n".join(["\t".join(SNAPSHOT_COLUMNS), *("\t".join(r) for r in rows)]) + "\n")
    return p


def test_name_match_is_candidate_never_accepted(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF, companies=_synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path))
    ms = next(c for c in _rows(out, "candidates.tsv") if c["developer"] == "Microsoft")
    assert ms["identity_status"] == NAME_CANDIDATE
    assert ms["company_key"] == "name:Microsoft"
    assert ms["company_id"] == "" and ms["company_id_candidate"] == "101"


def test_exact_keys_resolve_through_front_door(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    snap = CompanySnapshot.from_tsv(_synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path))
    got = resolve_many(
        [Reference(cik="102"), Reference(ticker="QQQZ"), Reference(name="Microsoft")], snap
    )
    assert got[Reference(cik="102")].status == RESOLVED  # CIK zero-padding tolerated
    assert got[Reference(cik="102")].company_id == 102
    assert got[Reference(ticker="QQQZ")].status == RESOLVED
    assert got[Reference(name="Microsoft")].status == NAME_CANDIDATE


def test_git_blob_matches_git() -> None:
    assert git_blob_sha1(b"") == "e69de29bb2d1d6280b6ba4dc8e3d8a5ec0cbb8b0"

@pytest.fixture
def praxis(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path / "praxis"
    shutil.copytree(FIX / "praxis", root)
    return root


def _rows(out: Path, name: str) -> list[dict]:
    return from_tsv((out / name).read_bytes())


def test_candidates_from_real_rows(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    r = build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    cands = _rows(out, "candidates.tsv")
    assert sorted(c["developer"] for c in cands) == [
        "Hugging Face",
        "Microsoft",
        "Technology Innovation Institute",
    ]
    for c in cands:
        assert c["proposed_code"] == "data_privacy"
        assert c["basis"] == "proposal" and c["witness"] == WITNESS
        assert c["review_status"] == "needs_cio_review"
        assert c["identity_status"] == "no_snapshot"
        assert c["company_key"] == f"name:{c['developer']}"
        assert c["as_of"] == AS_OF
    assert r.candidates_by_code == {"data_privacy": 3}
    # Unverified rows (terms-barred, no quote) never become candidates.
    assert not any(c["developer"] == "Anthropic" for c in cands)
    # "A; B" names two developers.
    devs = {f["developer"] for f in _rows(out, "findings.tsv")}
    assert {"Zhipu AI", "Tsinghua University"} <= devs
    assert verify(out, praxis) == []


def test_byte_identical_rebuild(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    a, b = tmp_path / "a", tmp_path / "b"
    build(praxis, a, AS_OF)
    build(praxis, b, AS_OF)
    names = sorted(p.name for p in a.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    assert "candidates.parquet" in names
    assert names == sorted(p.name for p in b.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    for n in names:
        assert (a / n).read_bytes() == (b / n).read_bytes(), n


def test_incremental_skip_and_cache(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    first = build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    assert not first.skipped and first.cached == []
    assert build(praxis, out, AS_OF).skipped
    later = build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06")
    assert "resources/topologies/training-methods/uses.tsv" in later.cached
    (out / "candidates.tsv").write_bytes(b"tampered\n")
    assert not build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06").skipped  # bad outputs force a rebuild


def test_benefit_claims_are_context_never_grounds(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    claims = praxis / "resources/topologies/ai-benefit-claims/claims.tsv"
    claims.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(FIX / "ai-benefit-claims-manifest-excerpt.tsv", claims)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    ctx = [c for c in _rows(out, "context.tsv") if c["source_map"] == "ai-benefit-claims"]
    assert len(ctx) == 2
    assert all(c["source_map"] == "training-methods" for c in _rows(out, "candidates.tsv"))

    codes = frozenset({"data_privacy"})
    bad = default_rules_bytes().replace(b"R001\ttraining-methods", b"R001\tai-benefit-claims")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not a ground map"):
        load_rules(bad, codes)


def test_rule_validation_fails_closed() -> None:
    codes = frozenset({"data_privacy"})
    rules = default_rules_bytes()
    assert len(load_rules(rules, codes)) == 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="approved_by"):
        load_rules(rules.replace(b"\tproposal\t", b"\tcomputed\t", 1), codes)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not in taxonomy"):
        load_rules(rules, frozenset({"surveillance_tech"}))


def test_sources_from_bodies(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    srcs = _rows(out, "sources.tsv")
    assert len(srcs) == 10
    aasb = next(s for s in srcs if s["source_key"] == "praxis-body:aasb")
    assert aasb["url"] == "https://www.aasb.gov.au/" and aasb["url_status"] == "unverified"
    assert all(s["review_status"] == "needs_cio_review" for s in srcs)


def test_verify_catches_tampered_quote(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    p = out / "candidates.tsv"
    p.write_bytes(p.read_bytes().replace(b"web data", b"web DATA", 1))
    assert any("digest mismatch" in x for x in verify(out, praxis))


def _synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    # SYNTHETIC research.companies rows: no live snapshot is available offline.
    rows = [
        ["101", "ZZZQ", "", "", "", "", "", "stock", "", "Microsoft", ""],
        ["102", "QQQZ", "", "0000000102", "", "", "", "stock", "", "Synthetic Co", ""],
    ]
    p = tmp_path / "companies.tsv"
    p.write_text("\n".join(["\t".join(SNAPSHOT_COLUMNS), *("\t".join(r) for r in rows)]) + "\n")
    return p


def test_name_match_is_candidate_never_accepted(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF, companies=_synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path))
    ms = next(c for c in _rows(out, "candidates.tsv") if c["developer"] == "Microsoft")
    assert ms["identity_status"] == NAME_CANDIDATE
    assert ms["company_key"] == "name:Microsoft"
    assert ms["company_id"] == "" and ms["company_id_candidate"] == "101"


def test_exact_keys_resolve_through_front_door(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    snap = CompanySnapshot.from_tsv(_synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path))
    got = resolve_many(
        [Reference(cik="102"), Reference(ticker="QQQZ"), Reference(name="Microsoft")], snap
    )
    assert got[Reference(cik="102")].status == RESOLVED  # CIK zero-padding tolerated
    assert got[Reference(cik="102")].company_id == 102
    assert got[Reference(ticker="QQQZ")].status == RESOLVED
    assert got[Reference(name="Microsoft")].status == NAME_CANDIDATE

def test_incremental_skip_and_cache(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    first = build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    assert not first.skipped and first.cached == []
    assert build(praxis, out, AS_OF).skipped
    later = build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06")
    assert "resources/topologies/training-methods/uses.tsv" in later.cached
    (out / "candidates.tsv").write_bytes(b"tampered\n")
    assert not build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06").skipped  # bad outputs force a rebuild

"""dark.exclusions_feed — real Praxis row excerpts, no database."""

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from dark.exclusions_feed import build, verify
from dark.exclusions_feed.feed import default_rules_bytes, from_tsv, load_rules
from dark.exclusions_feed.identity import (
    NAME_CANDIDATE,
    RESOLVED,
    SNAPSHOT_COLUMNS,
    CompanySnapshot,
    resolve_many,
)
from dark.exclusions_feed.inputs import git_blob_sha1
from dark.security_master import Reference

FIX = Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures" / "exclusions_feed"
AS_OF = "2026-11-05"
WITNESS = "llm:claude-opus-5-5 prompt=unrecorded"


@pytest.fixture
def praxis(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path / "praxis"
    shutil.copytree(FIX / "praxis", root)
    return root


def _rows(out: Path, name: str) -> list[dict]:
    return from_tsv((out / name).read_bytes())


def test_candidates_from_real_rows(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    r = build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    cands = _rows(out, "candidates.tsv")
    assert sorted(c["developer"] for c in cands) == [
        "Hugging Face",
        "Microsoft",
        "Technology Innovation Institute",
    ]
    for c in cands:
        assert c["proposed_code"] == "data_privacy"
        assert c["basis"] == "proposal" and c["witness"] == WITNESS
        assert c["review_status"] == "needs_cio_review"
        assert c["identity_status"] == "no_snapshot"
        assert c["company_key"] == f"name:{c['developer']}"
        assert c["as_of"] == AS_OF
    assert r.candidates_by_code == {"data_privacy": 3}
    # Unverified rows (terms-barred, no quote) never become candidates.
    assert not any(c["developer"] == "Anthropic" for c in cands)
    # "A; B" names two developers.
    devs = {f["developer"] for f in _rows(out, "findings.tsv")}
    assert {"Zhipu AI", "Tsinghua University"} <= devs
    assert verify(out, praxis) == []


def test_byte_identical_rebuild(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    a, b = tmp_path / "a", tmp_path / "b"
    build(praxis, a, AS_OF)
    build(praxis, b, AS_OF)
    names = sorted(p.name for p in a.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    assert "candidates.parquet" in names
    assert names == sorted(p.name for p in b.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    for n in names:
        assert (a / n).read_bytes() == (b / n).read_bytes(), n


def test_incremental_skip_and_cache(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    first = build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    assert not first.skipped and first.cached == []
    assert build(praxis, out, AS_OF).skipped
    later = build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06")
    assert "resources/topologies/training-methods/uses.tsv" in later.cached
    (out / "candidates.tsv").write_bytes(b"tampered\n")
    assert not build(praxis, out, "2026-11-06").skipped  # bad outputs force a rebuild


def test_benefit_claims_are_context_never_grounds(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    claims = praxis / "resources/topologies/ai-benefit-claims/claims.tsv"
    claims.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(FIX / "ai-benefit-claims-manifest-excerpt.tsv", claims)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    ctx = [c for c in _rows(out, "context.tsv") if c["source_map"] == "ai-benefit-claims"]
    assert len(ctx) == 2
    assert all(c["source_map"] == "training-methods" for c in _rows(out, "candidates.tsv"))

    codes = frozenset({"data_privacy"})
    bad = default_rules_bytes().replace(b"R001\ttraining-methods", b"R001\tai-benefit-claims")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not a ground map"):
        load_rules(bad, codes)


def test_rule_validation_fails_closed() -> None:
    codes = frozenset({"data_privacy"})
    rules = default_rules_bytes()
    assert len(load_rules(rules, codes)) == 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="approved_by"):
        load_rules(rules.replace(b"\tproposal\t", b"\tcomputed\t", 1), codes)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not in taxonomy"):
        load_rules(rules, frozenset({"surveillance_tech"}))


def test_sources_from_bodies(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    srcs = _rows(out, "sources.tsv")
    assert len(srcs) == 10
    aasb = next(s for s in srcs if s["source_key"] == "praxis-body:aasb")
    assert aasb["url"] == "https://www.aasb.gov.au/" and aasb["url_status"] == "unverified"
    assert all(s["review_status"] == "needs_cio_review" for s in srcs)


def test_verify_catches_tampered_quote(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF)
    p = out / "candidates.tsv"
    p.write_bytes(p.read_bytes().replace(b"web data", b"web DATA", 1))
    assert any("digest mismatch" in x for x in verify(out, praxis))


def _synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    # SYNTHETIC research.companies rows: no live snapshot is available offline.
    rows = [
        ["101", "ZZZQ", "", "", "", "", "", "stock", "", "Microsoft", ""],
        ["102", "QQQZ", "", "102", "", "", "", "stock", "", "Synthetic Co", ""],
    ]
    p = tmp_path / "companies.tsv"
    p.write_text("\n".join(["\t".join(SNAPSHOT_COLUMNS), *("\t".join(r) for r in rows)]) + "\n")
    return p


def test_name_match_is_candidate_never_accepted(praxis: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    build(praxis, out, AS_OF, companies=_synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path))
    ms = next(c for c in _rows(out, "candidates.tsv") if c["developer"] == "Microsoft")
    assert ms["identity_status"] == NAME_CANDIDATE
    assert ms["company_key"] == "name:Microsoft"
    assert ms["company_id"] == "" and ms["company_id_candidate"] == "101"


def test_exact_keys_resolve_through_front_door(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    snap = CompanySnapshot.from_tsv(_synthetic_snapshot(tmp_path))
    got = resolve_many(
        [Reference(cik="0000000102"), Reference(ticker="QQQZ"), Reference(name="Microsoft")], snap
    )
    assert got[Reference(cik="0000000102")].status == RESOLVED  # CIK zero-padding tolerated
    assert got[Reference(cik="0000000102")].company_id == 102
    assert got[Reference(ticker="QQQZ")].status == RESOLVED
    assert got[Reference(name="Microsoft")].status == NAME_CANDIDATE


def test_git_blob_matches_git() -> None:
    git = shutil.which("git")
    if git is None:
        pytest.skip("git not on PATH")
    path = FIX / "praxis" / "linked-data" / "taxonomy.json"
    want = subprocess.run(
        [git, "hash-object", "--no-filters", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True
    ).stdout.strip()
    assert git_blob_sha1(path.read_bytes()) == want
